ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 75% high-intensity white surface area against 25% low-intensity black perimeter and mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous region across the central interior; low-intensity black borders along distal and trailing edges; discrete black punctate spots distributed across the white field; large contiguous black patch located at the lower right proximal base.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying pixel-amplitudes detected along the entire visible trailing edge boundary, isolated from the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex mathematical curve fitted to the outer margins of both lobes, transitioning to a vertical sweep at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of localized, circular high-contrast pixel groups (barnacles) concentrated at the distal tips and along the outer leading edges of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark linear pixel disruptions oriented diagonally across the lower-medial section of the left fluke lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense barnacle colonization at the fluke extremities; distinct irregular indentations and notches on the trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique punctate pigmentation pattern concentrated heavily near the midline junction where the lobes meet the water line.
